final: SELECT AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_patient_pt, AVG(avg_tat_difference) AS avg_patient_tat_difference FROM (SELECT ID, AVG(PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(TAT - TAT2) AS avg_tat_difference FROM Laboratory AS l WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS u WHERE u.ID = l.ID AND u.`U-PRO` = '-') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS r WHERE r.ID = l.ID AND r.RA = '-') GROUP BY ID) AS per_patient
